verdict.rationale: Parse outputs structured JSON that includes figures and layout, and an agentic r-1 mode offers 'advanced chart extraction'. Variable chunking also treats figures as semantic boundaries. Position traceability is documented only for Extract citations, whose bounding boxes point to source text, not to figures or charts. Missing for 10: explicit VLM figure summaries/descriptions, image-crop output, documented per-figure bounding boxes and page numbers, independent or hands-on corroboration of chart extraction quality.
